tuition.title: Bentley Undergraduate Admission - Tuition and Financial Aid (2026-2027 cost of attendance)

cost.notes: 2026-27 first-year cost of attendance from Bentley's tuition page: tuition and fees $65,860, housing and food $22,010, books and supplies (estimate) $1,200, personal expenses (estimate) $1,550, plus a one-time $250 new student fee and a $520 student activity fee. The page's total for first-year international students is $94,270: it adds the $230 International Student Fee and the $2,650 health insurance (waivable with comparable coverage) to the domestic total of $91,390. The CDS G1 also lists tuition $65,860 but prints food and housing as $20,930 next to housing-only $13,200 and food-only $8,810; the page figure of $22,010 is used. CDS H6: Bentley checks only 'institutional non-need-based scholarship or grant aid is available' for nonresidents; 402 degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid, average $22,352, total $8,985,325. Bentley's page says need-based aid is for U.S. citizens and eligible permanent residents and that international applicants are automatically considered for merit scholarships.

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class (CDS C1, C2, C21). Totals are the male + female + unknown-sex rows (6,802 + 4,600 + 1 applied; 3,083 + 2,310 + 0 admitted; 697 + 436 enrolled); the residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international / unknown) add up to the same totals. 350 applicants (178 admitted, 30 enrolled) have an unknown residency and are not in the in-state / out-of-state figures. International (nonresident) first-years: 1,895 applied, 668 admitted, 133 enrolled. ED covers Early Decision (719 received, 460 admitted); Bentley has no Early Action. Bentley did not report the GPA ranges or the average high school GPA (C11/C12 blank); only 16% of enrolled first-years submitted a class rank (29% top tenth, 67% top quarter, 91% top half). SAT/ACT submission is optional: 29% (330 students) submitted the SAT and 4% (40) the ACT. Undergraduate enrollment (4,620) and the nonresident count (670) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures in B2.
